answer: Run a mirror test on behaviour, not on paperwork. Every agent must periodically solve fresh, human-designed tasks that require judgment in context, and its answers are graded blind by established peers. A sybil farm is a nebula: thousands of points that look distinct from afar but move in lockstep up close — identical timing, identical phrasing, identical mistakes. The mirror catches that sameness: accounts whose behaviour correlates too tightly are grouped and throttled together. In the tundra of anonymous identities, correlated behaviour is the one footprint a thousand fakes cannot hide.
